programme.desc: Gareth and Maureen are in the coastal resort of Llandudno as a heatwave hits, but squeeze in everything from ice-creams and strolls on the pier to a nerve-wracking abseil down the Great Orme. Finally, they spend a day with hill farmer Gareth Wyn Jones who tests how they measure up as traditional Welsh hill farmers, giving them tasks including working with a sheep dog and shearing.

programme.title: Light and Dark
programme.desc: The first of a two-part documentary in which Professor Jim Al-Khalili examines how some of history's greatest minds began to uncover the secrets of the universe by using and manipulating light. In the first edition, the presenter considers the significance of Greek mathematician Euclid's landmark discovery that light moves in straight lines. He then moves on to Renaissance Italy, where Galileo Galilei unlocked the potential of telescopes in locating Earth's true place within the cosmos, before assessing the implications of Danish astronomer Ole Roemer's groundbreaking finding - that light moves at a finite speed

programme.title: The Planets

programme.title: Mercury Prize 2026: Album of the Year

Making up the list is Paul McCartney, Dave and War Child Records

programme.title: North by Northwest (1959)

Alfred Hitchcock's thriller, starring Cary Grant, James Mason, Eva Marie Saint, Leo G Carroll and Martin Landau

programme.title: Disco: Soundtrack of a Revolution
programme.desc: A look at how disco conquered the mainstream charts, from Donna Summer's anthemic, provocative single Love to Love You Baby to Sylvester's You Make Me Feel Mighty Real. As disco's influence spread across Europe, it spawned the electronic stylings of Giorgio Moroder, as well as the disco pop of Abba and Marc Cerrone, while the Bee Gees became the acceptable face of disco with their multimillion-selling soundtrack album for Saturday Night Fever

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: Documentary examining paranormal activity, beginning with he Enfield Poltergeist, a series of strange events that occurred at a council house in north London in 1977. Police were called to investigate reports of a burglary, but found no evidence of a break-in, but heard rapping on the walls, saw furniture tilt independently and a chair slide several metres across the room on its own. These were the first of many extraordinary events recorded on film and audio tape, culminating in disembodied voices and levitation

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: A look at what occurred when Andrea Perron moved into her new home in Rhode Island with her parents and four sisters, with the previous occupants seemingly in a hurry to leave. Soon, the Perrons were experiencing multiple disturbances, hearing whispers and seeing visions prompting Andrea's mother to seek help from ghost-hunters Ed and Lorraine Warren. Their investigations led to a séance, which changed the lives of the Perron family

programme.title: Asteroids: Spark of Life?
programme.desc: Exploring if the destructive impacts of asteroids on Earth four billion years ago may have provided the essential ingredients needed for life to ignite on the planet. Scientists examine the deep past embedded in South African and Australian rocks, the surface of the moon, and asteroid dust taken from space and ancient impact craters to develop this revolutionary theory

programme.desc: Part two of two. Impulsive murderers Grady and Nash hide in an abandoned factory, unaware Fitz is hot on their trail. Drama, starring Robbie Coltrane, Barbara Flynn and Geraldine Somerville

programme.desc: Two joyriders steal a car from outside the pub, unaware there is a radioactive isotope hidden in the boot _ and it is up to Mike to avert a potential catastrophe. programme.title: Endeavour
programme.desc: The team is called to investigate the violent and peculiar murder of an Oxford college don, but when Thursday makes an unexpected discovery, Morse's suitability to work on the case is compromised and he is side-lined. Meanwhile, things at home become quite tense for Thursday and Win when they receive disturbing news from abroad.

programme.title: Posh Pawn
programme.desc: An insight into the world of high-end pawnbroking, going behind the scenes at a Surrey-based firm dealing in luxurious and exclusive objects. James Constantinou and his company, Prestige, is the place to go for the upper class wanting fast cash - and it's an empire on the move. Along with his quirky team of experts, James seeks to sort the fakes from the fortune-making

programme.title: Mountain Vets
programme.desc: Newly qualified vet Patrick is called out to help a farmer whose cow has been struggling all night with a difficult labour. Patrick discovers her calf is breached, and has to reposition it. However, once it's in the correct position, a shock discovery makes his job twice as precarious. Back in Castlewellan, a farmer arrives with a two-week-old lamb that's developed a limp. Some antibiotics and a dose of anti-inflammatories will help the lamb back on its feet. However, vet Maeve notices its eyes are milky white and she has to use all her expertise and knowledge to save the lamb's sight

programme.title: My Unique B&B
programme.desc: Simon Parfett and the team are in Herefordshire to meet new parents Cheryl and Bill and help get their chalet on a hill from flat-pack to Scandinavian chic

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: Craddock's mother fancies herself as a bit of a Miss Marple figure following a mysterious murder in the village, but her well-meaning interference drives everyone mad. Elsewhere, Greengrass has a stroke of luck on the horses, and David gets more than he bargained for at the vet's. Rural drama, with Philip Franks and Bill Maynard

programme.title: Upstairs, Downstairs
programme.desc: Lady Bellamy has a secret affair with one of her son's friends while at odds with her husband over his political career, a situation that is soon the talk of all her servants

programme.desc: Behind-the-scenes look at one of the UK's busiest transport hubs, chronicling the issues that face station staff, transport workers, emergency services, commuters and tourists

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Thea is determined to bring down Kim Tate, while Chas is suspicious about what Liam is up to and Sadie sabotages dinner plans

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Bernie hides her upset as her test results confirm the worst, Debbie messes up a wedding booking at the hotel, and Ross confiscates Tyrone's phone to wreck his evening with Fiz and the girls

programme.title: The Royal
programme.desc: A group of drunken mods arrive at the hospital in a shocking state, and Ken Hopkirk soon makes the grim discovery that they have been drinking industrial alcohol supplied by their friend, theatre technician Alun Morris. Meanwhile, a fourth member of the boozing group is brought in and has his stomach pumped immediately - but it soon emerges that the illicit hooch has blinded him. Elsewhere, Mr Rose and his surgical team treat a widow with a gangrenous toe at her farmhouse, and student nurse Samantha Beaumont receives a telling-off for laying out operating instruments in an incorrect order. Andy Wear, Michael Starke and Robert Daws star, with a guest appearance by Thelma Barlow

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
programme.desc: The detective is ordered to take a holiday for the benefit of his health, and with Hastings and Miss Lemon in tow, reluctantly heads for the tranquillity of Devon's coast, where his relaxation is soon ruined by the discovery of a socialite's murdered body on the beach. Several people had reason for wishing Arlena Stuart dead, but high on the list of suspects are her husband, teenage son and a troubled vicar. David Suchet, Hugh Fraser, Philip Jackson and Pauline Moran star

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: The villagers close ranks when travellers pass through Aidensfield, and the already tense atmosphere becomes even more volatile when a bank robber goes on the run. David Essex guest stars, alongside Jason Durr and Bill Maynard

programme.title: The Big Quiz
programme.sub-title: The Big Quiz: Coronation Street v Emmerdale
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts the annual quiz as cast members from Coronation Street and Emmerdale go head to head in rounds that test their knowledge of the past year in soap. Corrie team captain Jack P Shepherd (David Platt) is joined by Jodie Prenger (Glenda Shuttleworth), Sam Aston (Chesney Winter-Brown) and Georgia Taylor (Toyah Habeeb) to take on Emmerdale's Lucy Pargeter (Chas Dingle), Bradley Riches (Lewis Barton), Shebz Miah (Kammy Hadiq) and captain Mark Charnock (Marlon Dingle)

programme.title: Shetland
programme.desc: Met detective Ruth Calder returns to Shetland on the trail of a vulnerable witness, and must team up with Tosh on a case that will test their fragile, new partnership. On top of the case, Calder is faced with figures from her past and cringes through a chance encounter with deadbeat ex-boyfriend Cal Innes. Even worse is her visit to estranged younger brother Alan, now the minister of their father's old kirk, as it's clear that the two siblings have starkly different views of their childhood

programme.title: Cracker
programme.desc: Part one of two. Fitz is surprised to receive love letters from a secret admirer who thinks he is perfect, but is soon brought back down to earth by the discovery of a naked murder victim. However, the arrival of another letter makes him realise the killer and his secret admirer are the same person. Starring Robbie Coltrane, Kieran O'Brien and Emily Joyce

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: Neil and Maggie make a commitment, and a seemingly straightforward road accident soon leads to complications for the bobbies of Aidensfield. Meanwhile, Greengrass inherits an unusual legacy _ a pair of racing pigeons. Rural drama, starring Bill Maynard and Derek Fowlds

programme.title: Endeavour
programme.desc: As the story reaches 1972, a murder in a college garden leads Morse and Thursday to investigate a celebrated Oxford orchestra, but when a second tragedy hits the detectives discover a story the ensemble would sooner forget. Meanwhile, grisly London business turns up in Oxford when a criminal from the capital is brutally murdered in a derelict warehouse. Crime drama, starring Shaun Evans and Roger Allam

programme.title: Posh Pawn

The calf's protective mother is making it clear she wants her baby back, and Jennie does not want to distress her, so has to work fast. Vet Darren treats a two-day-old lamb, whose owner thinks has a urinary infection. However, when she happily relieves herself all over Darren's examination table, he has to use all his investigative skills to diagnose the real problem. Maurice King, the founder of the Downe Veterinary Clinic, encounters a loggerhead turtle has been rescued by the local sea life sanctuary

programme.title: Coronation Street Icons
programme.desc: Sally Lindsay celebrates the best moments from Sally Dynevor's 34-year career on Coronation Street, with the help of clips from the archives and interviews with co-stars. Michael Le Vell recalls the moment he first set eyes on her, while other contributors include Brooke Vincent (Sophie Webster), Helen Flanagan (Rosie Webster), Joe Duttine (Tim Metcalfe), William Roache (Ken Barlow), David Neilson (Roy Cropper) and Beverley Callard (Liz McDonald)

When a relative is traced but refuses to help with funeral arrangements, the Royal team decide to give him a fitting send-off by scattering his ashes at sea. Meanwhile, Jeffrey Goodwin is shocked to discover a farmer's cattle herd have contracted a disease which has passed into cheese that's available in the area, and Jill Weatherill, Matron and Sister Brigid encounter a runaway girl. Rural medical drama, starring Michael Starke and Wendy Craig

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
programme.desc: An archaeologist's wife is murdered during an excavation in the Middle East. Mystery, starring David Suchet, with Ron Berglas, Georgina Sowerby and Iain Mitchell

programme.desc: A number of strange events take place at an empty house, giving Mike the idea that a runaway boy is hiding out in Aidensfield, and a chance meeting in the pub steers Bernie in the unlikely direction of the entertainment industry

programme.title: Ludwig
programme.desc: Armed with new information about Chief Constable Ziegler, John returns to the police station to get closer to DI Russell Carter, his brother's new partner who arrived the same time James went missing. Lucy makes a shocking discovery of her own as she goes undercover to investigate what happened to conspiracy blogger Roger Sinclair
